title: Structural elements facilitate extreme long-range gene regulation at a human disease locus
authors: Chen L; Long HK; Park M; Swigut T; Boettiger AN; Wysocka J
one_liner_zh: 该文通过成像与聚合物模拟研究SOX9位点超长距离增强子-启动子互作及CTCF结构元件作用，虽涉及染色质拓扑与基因调控，但非蛋白质-DNA结合建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract:
Summary

Enhancer clusters overlapping disease-associated mutations in Pierre Robin sequence (PRS) patients regulate SOX9 expression at genomic distances over 1.25 megabases. We applied optical reconstruction of chromatin architecture (ORCA) imaging to trace 3D locus topology during PRS-enhancer activation. While we observed pronounced changes in locus topology between cell-types, analysis of single chromatin fiber traces revealed that these ensemble-average differences arise not from the presence of cell-type unique conformations, but through changes in frequency of commonly sampled topologies. We further identified two CTCF-bound elements, internal to the SOX9 topologically associating domain, which are positioned near its 3D geometric center and bridge enhancer-promoter contacts in a series of chromatin loops. Ablation of these elements results in diminished SOX9 expression and altered domain-wide contacts. Polymer models with uniform loading across the domain and frequent cohesin collisions recapitulate this multiloop, centrally clustered geometry, suggesting a mechanism for gene regulation over ultralong ranges.

Four short bullet points that convey the key message of the paper

SOX9 domain topology dynamically changes during a developmental transition Structural elements promote TAD-wide interactions, stripe formation and transcription Structural elements are CTCF-dependent and situated centrally in the 3D TAD structure Polymer simulations of multi-loop model best recapitulate topological features
abstract_zh:
摘要

在Pierre Robin序列征（PRS）患者中，与疾病相关突变重叠的增强子簇在超过1.25兆碱基的基因组距离上调控SOX9表达。我们应用染色质架构光学重建（ORCA）成像技术，追踪PRS增强子激活过程中的3D位点拓扑结构。虽然我们观察到细胞类型间位点拓扑的显著变化，但单染色质纤维轨迹分析揭示，这些集合平均差异并非源于细胞类型特有的构象存在，而是通过常见采样拓扑频率的变化产生。我们进一步鉴定了两个CTCF结合元件，位于SOX9拓扑关联结构域内部，它们定位于其3D几何中心附近，并通过一系列染色质环桥接增强子-启动子接触。这些元件的消融导致SOX9表达减少和域-wide接触改变。具有跨域均匀加载和频繁cohesin碰撞的聚合物模型重现了这种多环、中心聚集的几何结构，提示了超长距离基因调控的机制。

四个传达论文关键信息的简短要点

SOX9结构域拓扑在发育转变过程中动态变化 结构元件促进TAD-wide相互作用、条纹形成和转录 结构元件依赖CTCF且位于3D TAD结构中心 多环模型的聚合物模拟最佳重现拓扑特征
